en: Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of two large villas in a rural, hilly landscape. The left building is labeled "Villa Lydia" and the right, larger building with a tower-like structure is labeled "Villa Felsenburg." Trees, fenced gardens, and additional houses are visible in the background. At the top left there is printed red text indicating the location and altitude; a red handwritten number appears at the top right.
